explanation.explanation: Axes are flow cytometry parameters (FSC-A/H, SSC-A, Viability dye, and fluorescence markers such as CD4, CD19, Fas, IgD, IgM). By field convention these represent arbitrary/relative fluorescence or scatter intensity and are labeled by the detector/marker name; explicit units are not required or customarily reported.
Same as x-axis: flow cytometry intensity axes conventionally do not require explicit numeric units.
Axes (CD19, IgD) are flow cytometry fluorescence intensity parameters; units are conventionally implicit (arbitrary fluorescence units) and not required.
Axes (CD98, FSC-A) are flow cytometry parameters; scatter/fluorescence intensity axes do not require explicit units by convention.
Axes (IgD, NP, CD138) represent flow cytometry fluorescence intensity of the labeled marker/antigen; units are conventionally not stated for such arbitrary intensity scales.
Axes (IgM, Fas, CD38) are fluorescence intensity parameters that conventionally do not require explicit units.
Axes (CD44, PD-L2) are flow cytometry fluorescence intensity markers; by field convention these arbitrary intensity axes do not require explicit units.
Axes (CD62L, CD80) are flow cytometry fluorescence intensity markers; units are conventionally not required.
